verdict.rationale: The only mobile evidence is a conditional note that, after setup, you can open the same dot in the ChatGPT mobile app 'when the supporting update is available'. That implies mobile access through the general ChatGPT app rather than a dedicated, full-featured dots app. Setup and some functions, such as inspecting delegated work under Activity, are documented only for the desktop app. Missing for 10: confirmed current availability on mobile, explicit iOS and Android support, mobile feature parity (setup, Activity, controls, take-over of the dot's computer), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
